text: $QNT exploded, up about 70% to $173, trading a wide range from $99 to $195. $RUNE held steady, climbing roughly 18% to $0.79 after bouncing between $0.67 and $0.85. Meanwhile $XRP slipped close to 2%, down to $1.52, its lows hovering around $1.50. The gap’s widening fast – one side roaring ahead, the other barely holding on. Looks like the market’s rewarding the outliers while the rest just drifts.
